She explains that she was using her Forte to tune her memories. She can read memories off objects, but there's only so much the human brain can remember, so she has to periodically erase memories to make room for new ones. To help with the Dark Side investigation, she asks if she can borrow something you're carrying to retrace what you experienced in there. Based on Lucilla's current findings, the rabbit in the Dark Side is the source of the anomaly. She's come up with a few ways to counter it, and she wants you in her corner. Lucilla notes that the rabbit's attacks are highly selective. To determine how it chooses its targets, she proposes a coordinated investigation into the victims. You approach the victims and collect key personal belongings, and she will use her Forte to read the memories tied to them. Together, you'll dig through what she finds and look for answers. You track down Professor Sevi, who's already heard of your involvement in the New Solar Ceremony. As a sign of respect, he presents you with a medal. But the moment you mention the Dark Side incident, he shuts down. Clearly, there's something he's not saying. Using the medal you just received, Lucilla reads Professor Sevi's past memories. In the Dark Side, Professor Sevi encountered the rabbit and realized it was responsible for harming students, so he chased after it. When he activated his memory-type Forte, the rabbit transformed into him, trying to break his mind. Professor Sevi found himself trapped in a sealed space, face to face with his own dark self. This shadow version knew Sevi's research had stalled, so it offered a deal: surrender something of equal value to the truth he sought, and the answer would be his. Sevi placed the accomplishments he once took pride in on the scale, but their weight barely registered. Then his dark self tempted him to trade his very life for the truth. At that moment, Sevi regained clarity and turned it down. And to keep young students and obsessive researchers from gambling their lives on an unknown answer, he chose to bury what happened and never speak of it. Lucilla understands why Sevi stayed silent. But her investigation also uncovered a pattern: the rabbit only appears when someone uses a memory-type Forte in the Dark Side. There's one more thing Lucilla didn't tell you. Every victim since the celebration ended was a memory-type Resonator. And now, she's the only one left in the Academy who hasn't been targeted. Knowing the Fractsidus are coming for her, Lucilla decides to do what Sevi did—use her Forte in the Dark Side, draw the anomaly out, and put an end to this. The moment her signal cuts out, a mysterious Miko appears right beside her. The perspective returns to you. Before losing contact, Lucilla asked you to visit the Academy's archive for the backup riddles prepared for the celebration to control access to the Dark Side. Lucilla wants you to use a riddle unknown to the Fractsidus to generate a stable exit. Worried for Lucilla's safety, you decide to enter the Dark Side and join her after setting up the exit. Lucilla follows the rabbit into a movie theater. A title flashes on screen: "The Tragic Life of Lucilla," directed by Lucilla, starring Lucilla. The Fractsidus have taken her past, twisted parts out of context, and stitched them all into a movie. It shows her as a child subconsciously absorbing too many memories, until she couldn't tell what was hers anymore and began to lose herself. Then comes the ending they've predicted for her: Lucilla, at the Academy's helm, leading everyone straight into the abyss. Lucilla scoffs at the movie's utter lack of taste. Then a familiar voice echoes through the theater. The Fractsidus have decided to remake the film, redesigning Lucilla's life and creating an entirely different version of events. In the remake, Lucilla refuses the position of President, convinced that she's not talented and experienced enough for the role. In the remake, Lucilla refuses the position of President, convinced that she's not talented and experienced enough for the role. In the remake, a student confronts Lucilla in class, questioning the point of exploring the unknown if answers can never truly be known. In the remake, Lucilla quits her research group, fearful of results that don't match expectations. Accepting her own mediocrity, she chooses to stop moving forward. Actor Lucilla reenacts this remade life where Lucilla gave up the President's position, her right to explore, and ultimately her Forte. If everything is destined to fade anyway, why not just enjoy fleeting pleasure before disaster strikes? She attempts to negate everything the real Lucilla has accomplished, tempting her to stay in the Dark Side forever. But she miscalculated. Lucilla doesn't budge. She tells her exactly what drives her and Startorch Academy to keep moving forward. And with that, the rabbit's illusion shatters. You and Lucilla seize the rabbit. The Grand Architect speaks through it to deliver a new announcement: "In the next game, we'll be betting on the fate of Lahai-Roi. Will it go boom and vanish, or will the flames of Startorch keep burning?" Then the rabbit disappears. You ask about the Miko you saw earlier, but Lucilla urges you to leave. The Dark Side is unstable, and explanations can wait until you're out. Denia confronts the Grand Architect, reminding them of their promise that the Dark Side would not harm Sigrika or Rover. Unconcerned, the Architect points out that no one was actually hurt in the end. They mockingly thank everyone for their roles in this experiment exploring the opposite of the Void—testing the extent memory-type Resonators can resist "its" power. With that, the Grand Architect leaves with Denia to see to other matters awaiting their attention. Upon leaving the Dark Side, you reproach Lucilla for acting alone. She calmly explains that her confidence stemmed from having long since learned to confront her past honestly. She shares a story from her youth when, feeling lost, she met a Roya teacher. He taught her how to hold her own memories, respect others', and find meaning in whatever comes next.
